note: Threats added by hand for the threats lane (magpie/threats.py). One entry per threat: url is its primary document (an advisory, an incident report, a root-program bug or the reporter's disclosure site); also lists further primary documents; note is context for the editor, never a source. An entry is read for 14 days after its added date; after that the register keeps it. Never write a threat's words here: the lane writes them from the documents.
